data.narrative:
Galadyne is a pre-seed stage defense and security company founded by Chandler Luzsicza that has raised $4.8M to date. The comparable universe includes 10 peers across the Defense & Security sector: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Only one valuation method proved applicable. The stage-progression approach uses the $4.8M raised as a proxy for current valuation and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for pre-seed to next-stage advancement, yielding a $12M implied valuation. A peer-median analysis could not be completed due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Defense & Security sector—only one narrow-filter peer was identified against a minimum threshold of three datapoints required for statistical reliability.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10M to $14M, with $12M as the median. This range reflects conservative downside (15% discount to stage-progression result) and modest upside (15% premium). Key uncertainties center on the absence of direct peer multiples in this valuation range and stage, and the limited data on Galadyne's operational metrics, competitive positioning, or technical differentiation. Any refinement would require either additional narrow-stage comparables or performance data that could support revenue or customer-based approaches.
